First — what we're building

It's not a gaming café.
It's a real motorsport centre.

Eight pro racing rigs — one on a full 3-DOF motion platform — right in the middle of Nungambakkam. And it's run by the people behind ARKA Motorsports, a championship-winning race team with 130+ national titles. This isn't a screen in a mall. It's the real thing, built by racers.

And there's a lot more than racing

It's a whole journey under one roof.

  • People don't just drop in to drive — they come to learn. Our Motorsport Academy takes them from their very first lap to a real race car: sim mornings, real-track afternoons with ARKA.
  • We run our own championships and weekly hot-lap battles that keep people coming back.
  • And the best of them climb the Ladder — straight into actual race seats. This is where India's next drivers will start.
Drive. Train. Compete. All in one place — for the first time in India.
